corePassives.description: Ichigo gains 1 stack of Reishi Gathering every time he releases a special attack, increasing the DMG of subsequent special attacks by 20%. Stacks up to 2 times, and the effects lasts until the character is Severely Wounded or the stage ends.
corePassives.name: Reishi Gathering

corePassives.description: Each enemy hit by Ichigo's techniques increases the DMG of his next special attack by 40%, up to a maximum of 200%.
corePassives.name: Courage

corePassives.description: Increases all damage dealt by Ichigo by 25%.
corePassives.name: Resolve

name: Ichigo Kurosaki (Initial)
note: No build necessary for him, replacement unit will be available almost immediately.

skills.description:
Ichigo strikes 5 times with an unnamed Zanpakuto, dealing damage equal to 587.5% of ATK and accumulating Spiritual Pressure. ~~Arc Slash~~ At Max Spiritual Pressure, press and hold basic attack 
 Ichigo slashes with his Zanpakuto horizontally, dealing damage equal to 375% of ATK. ~~Mighty Slash~~ Tap basic attack immediately after performing a special attack or Perfect Dodge 
 Ichigo leaps into the air and smashes his massive Zanpakuto downward in a two-handed strike, dealing damage equal to 287.5% of ATK.
skills.name: Swing Strike

skills.description: Ichigo spins and slashes his blade forward, dealing damage equal to 360% of ATK and creating a cyclone that pulls nearby enemies toward him.
skills.name: Full Swing Strike

skills.description: Ichigo slashes rapidly with his Zanpakuto multiple times, dealing DMG equal to 1012.5% of ATK. At the end, he leaps into the air and delivers a finishing blow, dealing DMG equal to 692.5% of ATK. He then unleashes a Penetrating sword wave forward that disappears after 4 hits, dealing total DMG equal to 300% of ATK.
skills.name: Sword Wave Combo

skills.description: After withstanding an attack, Ichigo leaps into the air and performs a Downward Smash on the enemy, dealing DMG equal to 1337.5% of ATK. Press and hold the basic attack button immediately afterwards to release a special attack without consuming Spiritual Pressure.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: Dodge to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5s. Cooldown: 15s.
skills.name: Dodge
